stem: Quick check — Install and version Terraform providers. Which practice is correct?

choices.text: Treat budget alerts as a hard spend stop that deletes resources
Apply the objective directly: Install and version Terraform providers
Ignore least privilege and use the root user for speed
Leave hourly resources running overnight without teardown

rationale: Option A aligns with the published objective wording. B violates root/MFA guidance. C ignores teardown. D misstates AWS Budgets behavior (alerts do not stop spend).
